tests: Each mode exposes its own scene, eight illustrated symbol meanings and reel narration
The Temple replaces the reels with a playable treasure scene, commits once, and acknowledges without a spin
A new Temple chest still opens after a prior treasure scene was acknowledged
A Crystal journey resumes mid-bonus and totals only its three awarded spins
Pending Crystal spins from v20 migrate into a resumable journey without awarding anything again
The Forge controls block two reels, disable the unselected relaunch, and preserve held columns
The fifty-spin break preserves a pending bonus journey and does not consume its next free spin
Forge automatic play stops at reactor readiness and waits for the player to choose reels
Line, impact, count and transfer stages are presentation only, and skipping cancels future ticks
All six soundtracks are selected by world and bonus state on the music channel
Late decodes from abandoned worlds cannot replace the selected soundtrack
Leaving during a delayed bonus decode prevents all audio from starting in another screen
A delayed bonus sound cannot start after the player selects another world
Muting and volume zero stop bonus-state music while preserving its saved progress
scope: Exact production JavaScript, current DOM tree, saved-session transitions and mocked Web Audio. No physical audio output, browser geometry or Android execution.
